title: Sam Smith Laughs About a Mix-Up Over the Color Hazel
summary:
Singer Sam Smith made a funny mistake, and they are laughing about it.

Smith is a Grammy-winning singer from Britain. They visited "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" to talk about their fifth album, "Hazel Eyes." It came out in late August. Smith said the album is about love.

But the title has a problem. "I thought hazel eyes were brown, like hazelnut," Smith said. Hazel eyes are really a mix of colors, like brown, green and gold. The eyes the album is about are brown.

Smith found out about the mistake four months ago. By then, the album plans were already done. "All my clothes were brown for the whole album campaign. It's a nightmare," Smith said with a laugh. "It should've been called Hazelnut Eyes."

On the show, Smith sang the song "Oh Mother" with the TwoCity Chorus, a singing group with 28 members.
why_it_matters: It shows that everyone makes mistakes, and laughing about them can help.
